The snapshot-pinned apt mirror briefly hosted in the connector on this PR train (routes under `/snap/...` and `/apt-mirror/...`) moved out before ever deploying: it now lives in the standalone `apps/apt_mirror` project (a Cloudflare Worker serves the public routes straight from R2; cut/warm run as an operator CLI). The connector's `app.py` is again fully self-contained (the monorepo `apt_mirror` import would have failed at runtime on Modal), and the `boto3`/`imbue-common`/`loguru` image dependencies added for the mirror are gone.
